description: This file is a shell script used to test the behavior of Git's diff commands regarding whitespace differences. It sets up a repository, performs various diffs with whitespace options, and checks expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, setting up a testing environment and executing commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command that is expected to fail, verifying its failure behavior.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
